title: GQ: Merging and retrofitting data and models
description: GQ (GridQuery) is a collection of command-line programs for merging multiscale and multiresolution data and models, and retrofitting three-dimensional Earth models by adding shallow geotechnical layering, modifying their topography and bathymetry, and generating or applying statistically defined small-scale heterogeneities. GQ builds on BLEND and the Generic Mapping Tools (GMT).
